description: Compares buying a home with a fixed-rate mortgage against renting a similar home and investing the money not spent on the home, over the years someone plans to stay, the way SmartFin's rent vs buy calculator does. Both start with the same cash and spend the same each month; whichever costs less that month invests the difference. Returns the modeled money each choice leaves (home sold and loan paid, or kept as equity, against the investments), the difference, the first year-end at which buying leaves at least as much as renting, the starting rent at which both leave the same, the monthly payment, month-one costs and totals. Use when someone asks how renting and buying compare, how long they would need to stay for the two to cross, or what rent matches buying a home. Do not use for rental-property investing, for how much someone can borrow, for tax planning or for adjustable-rate loans. Rates are held constant; income-tax effects of owning and tax on the home sale are not modeled. It reports modeled money only and does not say whether to rent or buy. Amounts can be in any one currency; none is converted.

annual_rate_pct.description: Mortgage rate, % a year, fixed, 0 to 25. Default 6.5

buying_costs_pct.description: Closing costs when buying, % of price, 0 to 10. Default 3

cost_growth_pct.description: Yearly increase in insurance and HOA, % a year, -5 to 15. Default 3

currency.description: Currency for the amounts in the summary and the link. Default USD; amounts are never converted

down_payment_pct.description: Down payment, % of price, 0 to 100. Default 20

hoa_monthly.description: HOA or condo fees, a month, in the currency chosen, 0 to 10000. Default 0

home_insurance_yearly.description: Home insurance, a year, in the currency chosen, 0 to 100000. Default 1500

home_price.description: Home price, in the currency chosen, 1000 to 100000000. Default 400000

home_value_growth_pct.description: Home value growth, % a year, -10 to 15. Default 3

investment_return_pct.description: Return on invested savings, % a year, -10 to 20. Default 6

investment_tax_pct.description: Tax on investment gains, % of gains, 0 to 50. Default 0

keep_home.description: True: the home is kept at the end of the stay and counted as equity, not cash; false: it is sold. Default false

maintenance_pct.description: Maintenance, % of home value a year, 0 to 5. Default 1

monthly_rent.description: Monthly rent, a month, in the currency chosen, 1 to 1000000. Default 2000

pmi_pct.description: Mortgage insurance (PMI), % of loan a year, 0 to 3. Default 0

property_tax_pct.description: Property tax, % of home value a year, 0 to 5. Default 1

rent_increase_pct.description: Yearly rent increase, % a year, -10 to 15. Default 3

renters_insurance_monthly.description: Renter's insurance, a month, in the currency chosen, 0 to 1000. Default 0

selling_costs_pct.description: Agent and closing costs when selling, % of sale price, 0 to 10. Default 6

years_to_stay.description: Years you plan to stay, whole years, 1 to 40. Default 10
